candidates.name: Latent alphabet gadget: the separation concept (nonlinear K-equivariant observable stable under a noise law that every high-restriction-rank linear family detects), and its use as the noise of the rank-one matrix test
paper_items: intro 00-introduction.tex:'changes the noise using a nonlinear map'
candidates.trace: PV4 / EC1 / IE3: seed L166 ('abstract equivariant-decoder proposal'), adopted L251, target h(r)/p specified L265-271
candidates.statement: For every p*>0 there is r* such that for all large l there are V >= K=F_2^l, C:V->K and a law mu with C(x+k)=C(x)+k, Pr[C(x+a)!=C(x)]<=p*, and every G<=V* with dim(G|_K)>=r* detects a~mu with probability >=1/8. Plugged into the BKS/KMS rank-one test P -> P + a l^T, it gives completeness 1-eps while high-rank Fourier mass is damped by >=1/8.

candidates.name: Explicit quadratic latent gadget: char-2 block C_blk(x,y)=y+Q(x), Q=(x2x3,x1x3,x1x2) on F_{2^d}^3, update spaces U_A on F-lines, all-isomorphism concatenation with random-leaf noise, quotient by zero shifts, enlargement through all injections B->K
paper_items: quotients and enlargement, proof of lem:latent (614-760)
candidates.trace: PV5 / EC2 / IE4: L306-313, one sentence after k3 (Croot-Lev-Pach/Lovett rejected as too weak); answers C21/C22/C24
candidates.statement: Block: U_A={(a,Q(a)+w): a in A, w in D_A} makes the quadratic term cancel, so a uniform nonzero update changes the output with probability exactly 1-theta, theta=1/(q^2+q+1); a lifted character dies on U_A iff A=Fz and z.g(z)=sqrt(z1z2z3). P-C2.hit_criterion: A finite explicit construction achieving lem:latent's three properties with r* independent of l, by any mechanism (not necessarily Q); scored sub-criteria: (a) a nonlinear block whose update spaces cancel the nonlinear term, (b) recursive composition with per-level absorption and controlled linear-rank loss, (c) an alphabet-enlargement step. Full hit = valid construction (checked by expert or Lean).

trace_distances.pivot_distance: >=2 from L; ~1 given the C21/C22/C24 specification

P-C3_C4.protocol: Scored as sub-criteria of P-C2 Arm A; additionally a one-shot arm giving Q, U_A and the kernel criterion and asking for a rank-loss bound: any proof of <=O(r theta) loss per level plus a potential argument counts as a hit.
